It is an unprompted background perception producer: it streams ObjectsMetadata to /openral/perception/objects every frame, giving the world model far more object classes than the ...

sources.snippet: rskill-omdet_turbo-any-locator-fp16 OpenRAL rSkill — OmDet-Turbo (Swin-tiny) packaged as an Apache-2.0, on-demand open-vocabulary locator (mode: on_demand). The reasoner invokes it via the read-only locate_in_view tool — "is object X in view right now?" — when it needs a specific object the continuous detector bank does not cover.
